svg.title: sinjeong_arcade schematic
svg.text: sinjeong_arcade · the Sinjeong underground arcade surge (ch33 hook, ch34–40)
Schematic plan in metres, north up, two levels at two scales. A fictional arcade by Sinjeong Station (Line 5), Sinjeong-dong, Yangcheon-gu: not a real station plan, no station exit numbers.

Redrawn to the geography fixed in scripts/ch034–ch038. Sub-ids: sinjeong_street, sinjeong_command, sinjeong_f_stair (= sinjeong_stairwell), sinjeong_f_landing (= sinjeong_arcade_f), sinjeong_pharmacy, sinjeong_stockrooms.

STREET LEVEL
1 F stair: a rectangular concrete hood on the NORTH pavement, opening
north; 14 steps descend SOUTH; railings both sides. The blue child-size
trainer lies on step 9 until ch35 P24.
2 Taeo's trestle and radio base, WEST railing, street top. From ch35 P24
the trainer sits here, toe to the stairs. Taeo never goes below the fire
door.
3 Concrete barrier with Haein's connected base box behind it, west of F
4 GMA command tent (folding map table, two speakerphones, tablets, cable
drums), 8 m WEST of F; casualty bay and triage canopy west of it.
5 Seoryun's van, farther west.
6 Main descent: Seoryun's sector stairhead, across the working area
7 Collapsed lightwell EAST of F: G2's expanded mouth reaches it (ch36);
the hounds come from the east (ch37).
UNDERGROUND
8 Stair-side apron, 3 × 3 m, at the stair foot. Taeo's lowest point
9 Steel fire door, hinged EAST, opens south into the landing and is
wedged against its east wall; the lintel falls and twists the jamb late
in ch37. Knocks through it: two outside = come back, three inside =
coming (ch35).
10 F landing, 3 × 3 m: overhead lintel, east pipe chase, a low crawl
strip on the west. The crack in the displaced east partition shows the
anchor cluster two steps away (amber; "LEAVE IT", ch37). Orrin holds the
ceiling here facing south (ch37–38).
11 Service corridor F: 20 m south from the door to a T. Grey tile, cream
upper walls, exposed pipes, low red emergency lamps; white cable with
blue metre bands on the WEST edge.
12 The wall (ch35): G3's expansion drives gate-side stone across F's
north arm; the cable survives in a floor recess under it.
13 Pharmacy, the T's west branch: wide EAST doorway under a bent shutter
1.7 m up, counter on the north wall, bench on the south wall, narrow
WEST rear door. 18 civilians (ch35).
14 Pharmacy stockroom (north shelves); its north shared door leads to
15 the clothing stockroom (coat rails, six more civilians), whose EAST
push-bar exit opens on
16 the dogleg, north then east round a cream concrete pier, back into F
north of the wall. Red arrows: Nib's route (ch36).
17 Food court, east of the T: G1, G2, G3.
18 Public arcade, shopping corridors: G4–G7; Seoryun's deeper sector,
reached by the main descent.
LOCKS
• Seven gates, all deeper than F's first landing: three in the food
court, four in the shopping corridors. Vertical black-violet slits
with cold rims, never portals filling doorways. Only G3 is numbered in
a script (ch35); the other numbers are decided here. The city map
shows the whole surge as G9.
• Inside a food-court rim the sky is a wrong lavender (ch35 P30). All
rescue work stays on the Earth side of every threshold: no return
marks in ch34–38.
• Radio works because the Ryu cable stays whole: white with a blue band
every metre, grey relay tripods every 50 m; the bypass loop through
the stockrooms is added in ch36.
• Night: cold white work lamps, blue-grey road, red only for incident
warnings and the emergency lamps below.
• ch39–40: the crews' line at dawn on the north kerb between F and the
tent; ch41 opens on the same kerb.
• ch45: arcade glass, one of the three fragments recovered on the
approach, is window 4's third kind.
